_note: Neutral voice. Show one at random on open, never the same twice in a row. {target} becomes the student's target mark.
lines: Every lecture you show up for is a brick in the wall. Keep building.
Small steps count. One topic today is still progress.
You've learned harder things than this before.
Slow and steady still gets the first.
Be proud of how far you've already come.
Future you says thank you.
Ten focused minutes beat an hour of worrying.
Mistakes are just your brain finding the edges of what it knows.
You don't have to be perfect, just a little better than yesterday.
Deep breath. You've got this.
Coffee, notes, Pencil — let's go.
One practical at a time.
Hard weeks end. What you learn in them stays.
Your patients will be lucky to have you.
Rest is part of revision too.
You're closer to {target}% than you think.
Tiny wins today: pick one topic and own it.
Show yourself the patience you'd show a nervous patient.
Look how many things you can explain now that you couldn't last year.
Today is a good day to tick something off.
